_comment: Source of truth for gigs until the Google Calendar exists. Once it does, a build step will fetch the calendar's public .ics and regenerate this file — the shape below is what the page consumes, so nothing else has to change.

_schema.title: what to call the gig
_schema.address: optional street address, improves the map/rich result
_schema.url: optional — tickets or event page; renders a Details button
_schema.note: optional short line, e.g. 'Quintet' or 'Dance lesson at 7:30'
